task: Add contract editor controls, a severity-grouped issues panel with coverage summary, Check/dry-run, saved-with-warnings outcomes and Save-and-Run behavior to the workflow visual editor (EPMCDME-16505).

key_reasoning.reason: Touches pages (EditWorkflowPage, NewWorkflowPage, EditWorkflowHeaderActions, useWorkflowHistoryRestore), editor shell (WorkflowEditor, EditorActions, IssuesPanel), issue machinery (useWorkflowIssues, useWorkflowFieldIssues, FieldController, visualEditorFieldRegistry, processBackendError), config panels (CommonStateFields, SubWorkflowTab, AdvancedConfigTab), nodes, store, and shared Input/Textarea. Severity is a new concept every issue consumer must learn; the shared form components are core utilities.

31 acceptance criteria are detailed, but the backend contract from EPMCDME-16504 (error type string, severity field, coverage object, validate-before-save endpoint, whether warnings travel in success warnings[] or details.errors[]) is unverified in this repo, and the strict-mode tag source is unknown. The ticket reverses current behaviour (issues reset on save, restore closes panel), so rework risk is real.

Closest pattern is the existing error-type whitelist, per-panel field registry and issue-to-field binding. It treats every issue as an error, so severity (FieldController, nodeHasError, Issues button, IssuesPanel) diverges from it. Saved-with-warnings state touches useUnsavedChanges baseline semantics (not inspected). Several touched pieces (IssuesPanel, useWorkflowFieldIssues, FieldController, EditWorkflowHeaderActions) have no tests. Registry and rendered controls already diverge.

Technical analysis estimates roughly 25+ files across pages, editor, panels, hooks, utils, store, types and shared form components, plus new components (coverage summary, contract controls), which is XXL on file count.
UI, store/API client, utils/service logic, and a new external backend contract (id-less validate endpoint, new issue shape). Severity is cross-cutting across several of these. No DB or infra.
